drop: Drop an OFD here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable OFD file. The file may be damaged or incomplete.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This document uses unsupported graphics or has missing page content. No incomplete PDF was created.
signature: This file contains digital signatures or embedded seals that cannot be included reliably. No PDF was created. Export it with an OFD application that supports those features.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fontNotice: Some fonts were substituted. Check the text, amounts, and alignment in the preview before downloading.
fidelity: All documents and their pages are included in package order, with their original page sizes and orientation. Pages are rendered as images at 150 DPI.
limitations: The PDF has no selectable text, OCR, links, or interactive fields. Digital signatures and embedded seals are not preserved or verified; files containing them are rejected. Unsupported graphics or missing content also stop conversion.
